notes.title: Version 1.2 update
notes.content:
When upgrading, the number of skills available for selection becomes 4.
Monsters will occasionally talk when attacking.

New hero skill - Divine Thunder.
New hero skill - Curse of Shadow.
New hero skill - Blasting spears.
New hero skill - Lightning.

New hero passive skill - Balance.

Slippery, new talent - Soft.
Spiny Turtle, new talent - Spikes.
Skeleton, new talent - Buckler.
Bumblebee, new talent - Venom.
Mimic, new talent - Double Ring.
Spider, new talent - Spider Silk.

tags.feature: New hero skill - Curse of Shadow.

notes.title: Version 1.1 update
notes.content:
New hero - Dragon Fruit.
New hero - Coconut.
New monster - werewolf.
New Monster - Old Man.

New enhanced skill - evasion.
Add enhanced skill - gear.
New enhanced skill - hit.

Add character attributes, dodge and block.
Add dropped items, recycling cans, and ice crystals.

New hero skill - Frost Battle Axe.
New hero skill - healing.
Add hero skills - weapon library.
New hero skill - Tornado.

New hero passive skill - dodge.
New hero passive skill - Block.
New hero passive skill - Direct Strike.

In survival mode, the initial difficulty decreases.
In survival mode, elite monsters have added drop items - advanced experience.
In survival mode, the hero displays the pickup range.
In survival mode, add operation evasion.

In the resistance mode, add a mouse wheel to switch monsters.
In the resistance mode, a refresh function is added when obtaining skills.
In resistance mode, the hero's movement speed decreases.
In the resistance mode, a new operation called free summoning has been added.

Game title optimization.
Game help page optimization.
Settings - Volume, split into background music and sound effects.
Improve the recognition of mouse pointers in games.
Heroes' damage numbers are displayed when they are hit.
UI modification of detailed character information and visualization of attributes.
New skill cooldown reminder.
Partial monster attack range addition prompt.
Partial localized text modification.

The difficulty of the game has slightly decreased.
Partial passive skill level improvement.
Partial adjustment of basic attributes for certain roles.
Partial adjustment of character skill values.
Monster death animation accelerates.
Cancel tracking during Friends raid, increase raid speed.

Occasional disappearance of the problem before the outbreak of explosive inflammation.
Abnormal color issue with damage numbers.
The issue of pausing when a hero dies.
